title: The Principle of Least Privilege Explained Simple
description:
In  @Heimdalcompany 's newest video, Antonia talks about a cybersecurity approach that has become increasingly popular over the last few years - the Principle of Least Privilege or POLP. 

Check out this video and discover what POLP is, how it benefits organizations, and best practices when implementing the least privilege in your IT environment.
